fundamental.name: Forcas Studio Ltd
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 88.0% CAGR over last 5 years
Debtor days have improved from 165 to 121 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend

strengths.point: ROCE runs well ahead of the sector median.
ROE runs well ahead of the sector median.

weaknesses.point: The share price has run ahead of the fundamentals.

opportunities.point: The company remains confident of delivering approximately 25% to 30% annual growth while continuing to improve profitability and brand strength.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Based on our current visibility and expansion plans, we remain confident of delivering approximately 25% to 30% annual growth while continuing to improve profitability and brand strength." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Quick commerce revenue is expected to reach 5% to 10% of total revenue.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "I believe going forward, quick commerce should be at least, between 5% to 10% of our total revenue." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company announced its planned expansion into Quick Comm during FY27 by preparing to partner with more quick commerce platforms.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "In line with this vision, we are pleased to announce our planned expansion into Quick Comm during FY27." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company plans to aggressively expand the brand TRIBE into men and women premium bottoms.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Going forward, we will aggressively expand TRIBE into men and women premium bottoms." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: P/E is cheaper than the sector median.
Rising institutional interest can keep supporting the price.
opportunities.evidence: POSITIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change 0.01 pp

opportunities.point: Management stated that the Indian organized fashion market continues to offer long-term opportunities.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The Indian organized fashion market continues to offer long-term opportunities." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management believes that the next large opportunity in fashion will emerge through Quick Comm and instant fashion delivery.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "We believe the next large opportunity in fashion will emerge through Quick Comm and instant fashion delivery." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that the company is currently at 120 stores on Zepto for Quick Comm expansion.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Today we are at 120 stores and also, we are expanding our SKUs and designs in all those." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Goods are currently stocked across nine states for e-commerce and over 15 to 16 cities for quick commerce.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "So today, our goods are being stocked at around nine states. And that is for e-commerce, and for quick commerce it is being stocked at more than 15 - 16 cities in their dark store through which it is, again, dispatched and delivered through around 50 to 60..." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company plans to be live on Flipkart Minutes by next month.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Going forward, probably by next month itself, we should be live on Flipkart Minutes." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01) [next month]

opportunities.point: Management stated that the FY27 focus will be scaling brands, expanding Quick Commerce presence, strengthening omni-channel distribution, improving margins, and building stronger consumer connect.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So, our FY27 focus will be scaling our brands, expanding Quick Commerce presence, strengthening our omni-channel distribution, improving our margins and building stronger consumer connect." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01) [FY27]

threats.point: Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -2.61 pp, DII -2.47 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Management noted talent acquisition and the brandification process as the two main challenges or bottlenecks to solve.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "I believe, honestly, there are two challenges which we need to solve. Number one, yes, talent is one thing which we need to focus more on and need to hire more people from the industry and established brands. And number two is the brandification process, it..." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: The market is experiencing a raw material crisis and a supply shortage for winter wear.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "And there is a huge crisis of the raw material. But with us, the situation is completely different. Our targets for the winter wear sales are almost going to be achieved or probably we will overachieve that." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S9/W7/O28/T8), led by 'The company remains confident of delivering approximately 25% to 30% annual growth while continuing to improve profitability and brand strength', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
